bug_semantics: A local-auth login registers a random SID in server-side SessionStorage for about one year, and authenticated API requests accept that SID from the olivetin-sid-local cookie. Logout later expires only the browser cookie and does not delete the SID, so anyone retaining the old cookie can replay it after logout and remain authenticated until server-side expiry. The closing fix also handles OAuth2's separate registeredStates store.
flaw_origin: Commit a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 is the smallest real BIC: its sole-file change adds the missing local-cookie fallback to UserFromContext, reads olivetin-sid-local, calls auth.GetUserSession("local", SID), and returns the stored user without adding any corresponding logout revocation. Earlier migration commit a62d58f11955fe192f45da13e23ba996a2759404 had dropped the old gRPC logout-to-response revocation handoff, and 3b8bc49b04d22aff94003e27725f60ff854d0a97 had created the replacement one-year SessionStorage, but the direct parent of a7e7bf8 still did not authenticate API requests from that cookie; a7e7bf8 is where the end-to-end replay path first became real.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file commit a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9` shows author and committer `jamesread <contact@jread.com>`, subject `fix: WIP on login regression`, and no message body, Co-authored-by, Generated-with, or other AI trailer; neither identity is a bot.
evidence: First-party GHSA-gq2m-77hf-vwgh states that logout clears the browser cookie while SessionStorage continues accepting the SID for about one year, gives a login/logout/WhoAmI replay PoC, identifies affected versions `< 3000.11.1`, and names 3000.11.1 as patched. In the validated clone, `git log -L ':UserFromContext:service/internal/acl/acl.go' a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9` shows a7e7bf8 adding the olivetin-sid-local cookie parse and `auth.GetUserSession("local", c.Value)` acceptance. `git log --all --reverse -S'GetUserSession("local"' -- service/internal` independently identifies the 3b8bc49 storage call, its later a7e7bf8 authentication wiring, and the be7c754 refactor; `git log --all --reverse -S'func userFromLocalSession' -- service/internal/acl/acl.go` also identifies a7e7bf8's lineage before later extraction. Direct-parent verification: `git show 0dd9e9b2b7e9b8f3e9b0617efbe19c7ea267da85:service/internal/acl/acl.go` shows UserFromContext reading only username/usergroup/provider headers and otherwise returning guest, with no cookie parse or GetUserSession call; therefore replaying a local SID cookie cannot authenticate in that parent. Lifecycle cross-check: `git show a62d58f11955fe192f45da13e23ba996a2759404` shows the Connect migration commenting out the old logout-provider/logout-sid handoff while its parent d4fe9eaa793f508f44bc60f0a1109cb008a6a5b0 sends both values and `forwardResponseHandlerLogout` deletes registeredStates and calls deleteLocalUserSession; `git show 3b8bc49b04d22aff94003e27725f60ff854d0a97 -- service/internal/auth/sessions.go service/internal/api/api.go` creates the replacement one-year RegisterUserSession/GetUserSession store and login cookie but still leaves Logout a no-op; `git show 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 -- service/internal/api/api.go` later implements browser-cookie expiry without server deletion, matching the advisory's final vulnerable shape. `git tag --contains a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 --sort=version:refname` starts at 3000.1.0, while 3000.0.2 predates it. For closure, `git show d6a0abc3755d43107be1939567c52953bcbec3d5` adds Logout's `RevokeSessionForProvider`, local `RevokeUserSession` deletion/persistence, and OAuth2 registeredStates deletion; its direct parent is 235493e471249b07cf20abdf5850f9ba38d8effa, the 3000.11.0 tag. `git tag --contains d6a0abc3755d43107be1939567c52953bcbec3d5 --sort=version:refname` starts at 3000.11.1, confirming the fix boundary. `git cat-file commit a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9` reproduces the BIC-only marker check.
reasoning: The BIC is not the broad a62d58f migration scaffold, the 3b8bc49 storage groundwork, the 8686a56 cookie-clearing follow-up, or the be7c754 auth refactor. The first two did not yet provide the complete local-cookie-to-authenticated-API replay path, 8686a56's parent was already vulnerable once a stolen SID was supplied, and be7c754 merely preserved an existing cookie lookup. The one-file a7e7bf8 change is the smallest commit whose parent cannot authenticate an API request from the SID cookie and whose child can; because Logout has no server-side deletion, that change completes the but-for attack path. The direct fix revokes the exact provider/SID before returning expired cookies and is first shipped in 3000.11.1. Since the a7e7bf8 commit object has a human author/committer and no canonical AI attribution or bot signal, the required BIC-only judgment is NOT_AI.
